title: Lists, Dicts & Message History Management
why: LLM APIs expect conversation history as a list of message dictionaries: [{'role': 'user', 'content': '...'}]. You must manipulate, filter, and summarize message lists smoothly.
objectives: Sliding window memory with list slicing
Fast deduplication using sets for retrieved citations
concept: To prevent exceeding the context window, memory mechanisms use a sliding window (e.g. keeping only the last N messages) or prune older tool call messages while keeping system and summary messages intact.

practice.description: Create a function that removes consecutive duplicate user messages from a chat history list.
practice.hint: Iterate through items checking if the current item matches previous item.

requirements: Receive list of retrieved chunk dictionaries with source URLs
Use set operations to return unique list of cited URLs sorted alphabetically

checklist: Constructed compliant OpenAI message payload format
Built working sliding window memory buffer
Used list comprehensions for filtering chat roles
mistakes: Accidentally slicing away the system message when trimming history
